description.value: Those you hunt have one foot in the grave already. Once per day when you use Pitiless Pursuit, you can enhance your pursuit with primal magic. You gain a status bonus to your Nature check equal to your quarry's wounded value. If you succeed, the creature also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 1}, and if you critically succeed, the creature also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Doomed]{Doomed 1}.
